name: Beetroot Coconut Soup
ingredients: 100 g silken tofu, to blend in
steps: Heat the oil, add cumin and onion and cook for 4 minutes. Add ginger.
Add the beetroot, red lentils and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes until the beetroot is tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and warm gently without boiling.
Blend the silken tofu in with the beetroot for protein and creaminess.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: Beetroot stains: use a wooden spoon and blend with care. The small amount of red lentil adds body and protein.
